split: Per-user sorted item IDs shuffled with seed+stable user index. n>=6: test=3, validation=1, train=rest. n<6: train-only.
no_temporal_claim: No timestamps in ratings. This is retrospective held-out ratings, not forecasting future visits.
selection_metric: validation MAE, tie break by fixed model/grid order
secondary_metric: tie-aware NDCG@3 ONLY among the three held-out rated items per user with positive ideal gain
bootstrap: 2000 paired resamples of evaluation users; conditional on this fitted model/split, not population generalization
cold_start: Users unseen during fit fall back to train-only item/global estimate.
